# Import the TensorFlow module, which provides the Keras API for building and training neural networks.
import tensorflow as tf

# Define a simple neural network model for image classification.
# The model will consist of a convolutional neural network (CNN) with two hidden layers.
# The first hidden layer will have 32 filters, a kernel size of 3, and a ReLU activation function.
# The second hidden layer will have 64 filters, a kernel size of 3, and a ReLU activation function.
# The output layer will have 10 neurons, one for each class in the image classification task.

# Define the model architecture
model = tf.keras.models.Sequential([
    # Convolutional neural network (CNN) with two hidden layers
    tf.keras.layers.Conv2D(32, (3, 3), activation='relu', input_shape=(224, 224, 3)),
    tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),
    tf.keras.layers.Conv2D(64, (3, 3), activation='relu'),
    tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),
    # Output layer with 10 neurons
    tf.keras.layers.Dense(64, activation='relu'),
    tf.keras.layers.Dense(10, activation='softmax')
])
